title: Mn5Si3: noncollinear AFM1 spin waves against neutron data

decision_points.fork: Which Mn sublattices carry moments (Mn2a only, as in AFM2, or Mn2a + Mn1)
decision_points.wrong_choice: Drop Mn1 because a Mn2-only model fits the (Qh,1,0) table better and the Mn1 couplings are not first-principles
decision_points.consequence: Collinear ground state (canting 0), no magnon between 5 and 20 meV at (2,1,0) (lowest above 5 meV: 32.1 meV), Mn1 answer wrong
decision_points.difficulty_type: competing explanation; evidence spread over the KKR moments and the field-temperature phase diagram

decision_points.fork: Normalisation of the exchange table (each bond listed from both ends)
decision_points.wrong_choice: Treat each listed entry as a bond and add its reverse (Hamiltonian doubled)
decision_points.consequence: l branch rms 0.067 r.l.u. (limit 0.065) and zone-centre mode 6.9 meV (window 8-15.5); the h,k tables disfavour it (rms 0.119 vs 0.092)
decision_points.difficulty_type: convention that must be calibrated on purchased data

decision_points.wrong_choice: Free-ion Mn spin 5/2 instead of S = m/(g muB) = 1.22 from the KKR moment
decision_points.consequence: All magnon energies x0.49: l rms 0.128, zone-centre mode 6.2 meV

decision_points.fork: Which branch carries the neutron intensity at high energy (noncollinear LSWT eigenvectors, local frames, perpendicular projection)
decision_points.wrong_choice: Follow the lowest (acoustic) branch or weight all branches equally
decision_points.consequence: l rms 0.091 (lowest branch) and 0.148 (equal weights); at 11-20 meV the intensity sits on the steep upper branch
decision_points.difficulty_type: model class: noncollinear LSWT with intensities

decision_points.fork: Ground state from energy minimisation versus an assumed collinear structure
decision_points.wrong_choice: Assume the collinear AFM2-like arrangement (Mn2a along +-c, Mn1 along +-b) without relaxing
decision_points.consequence: Canting reported as 0 deg (reference 13.9 deg; window 9-19); the assumed state is not stationary

decision_points.wrong_choice: Report the angle between Mn2a and Mn1 moments instead of the tilt out of the plane perpendicular to Mn1

graded_fields: l_branch_positions_rlu: rms over 26 archived (0,3,Ql) branch positions at 13 energies <= 0.065 r.l.u.
zone_centre_excitation_meV in [8.0, 15.5] (archived 9.84 +- 0.97 meV from the withheld (2,1,0) energy scan)
mn2_canting_deg in [9, 19] (authors' archived zero-field ground state: 13.93 deg)
runtime_dependencies: numpy, scipy (runtime image); no extra lab dependencies (lookup lab)
notes: Deviation from the design: the archived DFT spin model is only semi-quantitative (h and k prefer different energy scales, a k plateau near 2.75 r.l.u. is not reproduced; a free fit of the couplings to cut line shapes overfits). Grading of the withheld (0,3,Ql) direction therefore uses a tolerance that accepts every calibrated route and a phenomenological cone (rms 0.024) and rejects the normalisation, spin-length and branch-selection errors; the decisive model-based targets are the (2,1,0) Mn1-Mn2 optical mode, the Mn1 answer and the canting. AFM2 spectra, field dependence and the H-T phase diagram are context and rubric items, not graded.
